answers.reason: Students are not mentioned as members of the senate, which decides on statutes, structure, and strategy of the whole university.
Students do not take part in budget planning rounds as these allocate funds rather than handle student matters.
Appointment committees select candidates for vacant professorships, a matter outside student affairs.
Faculty councils decide on the affairs of one faculty including study regulations, which directly concern students.
Examination boards decide on examination matters of individual students such as recognition of credits and appeals.
